blocked_by: M2417 target consolidation must be audited before repair planning

workflow_synthesis.evidence_increment: audits whether M2417 target consolidation provides a bounded next decision

stop_condition: stop if M2417 target consolidation is incomplete or has guardrail failures
stop if consolidated targets are still too broad for bounded repair planning
stop if family/profile slices are used as ranking
stop if the audit routes directly to repair execution without synthesis or repair-plan materialization
fallback_plan: route to branch synthesis if the source-linked branch has reached synthesis cadence
route to bounded repair-plan materialization if consolidation is compact and cadence allows
stop or pivot if the artifact is invalid or too broad
workflow_synthesis.synthesis_trigger: synthesize after at most 10 milestones in this branch or if consolidation adds no decision value

one follow-up manifest selected by the audit

no controller ranking, candidate-family ranking, paper-level result, finite-window-vs-GRU result, scenario-redesign-executed result, training-repair result, current-sim verdict, or level3 self-identification claim
